issues.evidence: Dense Gram dispatch and support compression shipped; model-wide tabmat exclusion and retained storage remain performance work.

issues.title: Make kind="cr" mean the cardinal cubic regression spline
issues.evidence: Naming proposal remains; public cr_cardinal m=1 silently uses the m=2 penalty. Constructor/order guard fix underway.
issues.proposed_fix: Reject unsupported cardinal penalty orders at construction and structural-penalty entry; accepted m=2 fit retained bitwise.

issues.title: The delivered pencil is not always definite: poles of the exact edf sit inside the ladder's own bracket
issues.evidence: Delivered-moment premise superseded by design-factor routes; alleged old stacked-QR oracle violates independently resolved rank ceiling. Any remaining deflation policy needs a new valid case.

issues.title: The near-absorbed pair's low bracket edge is refused: the range guard's allowance carries no deflation term
issues.evidence: Fixed by 23fedf04 (#407); current half-EDF and crossover regressions pass against closed forms.

issues.title: The impact sheet stabilizes the discretized predictor; the workbook it describes does not
issues.evidence: Actual fitted/exported cancellation case understates maximum workbook error by 1.79e12 because impact stabilizes the approximation.
issues.proposed_fix: Measure unbounded workbook-equivalent approximations, reject nonfinite selected-resolution outputs, and stabilize diagnostic correlation arithmetic.

issues.title: The binned offset multiplier block is not covered by the discretization impact sweep
issues.evidence: Default offset export is now exact; explicitly requested binned-offset summary omits its error from joint impact.
issues.proposed_fix: Share offset bins between exported factors and joint impact; categorical-only binned-offset exports now disclose their approximation.

issues.title: The penalty-root cut is eigh's error bar, but the negativity it now refuses on is made by the assembly
issues.evidence: Guard exists, but current QR projection bases are orthonormal; 36 constructor configurations produce no refusal. Proposed unbounded-conditioning premise is unproved.

issues.title: REML under-shrinks a crossed RandomEffect when neighbouring unpenalised levels separate
issues.evidence: Exact Tweedie scale criterion fixed; independent fixtures pass. Remaining reference disagreement was explained by weight conventions.

issues.title: The pre-commit ruff hook and the pinned ruff are two different versions, and nothing asserts they agree
issues.evidence: Ruff hook v0.15.22 differs from project 0.16.3; pin synchronization and agreement regression implemented locally.
issues.proposed_fix: Synchronize Ruff hook with the project pin and guard agreement.

issues.title: The Gram rank cut sits below eigh's resolution, so the sign clip is what actually drops a direction
issues.evidence: Gram rank floor and public covariance paths fixed; old consumers deleted. Remaining direct-consumer audit is research without demonstrated current public error.

issues.title: SCOP's stall verdict rests on gates neither cited method supplies, and re-deciding them has cost forty commits
issues.evidence: Requested literature assessment already supplied in maintainer comment; any remaining documentation/policy work needs concrete scope.

issues.title: The factor route refuses a positively-weighted level whose covariate spread overflows the shift, where the moment route screened it
issues.evidence: Raw within-level covariate shift overflows for finite weighted geometry; weighted-row QR gives finite reference statistic/EDF/variance.
issues.proposed_fix: Recover nonfinite raw-centered level factors through chunked weighted-row QR; preserve ordinary factor arithmetic.

issues.title: Anderson(1) acceleration stores the accelerated point in its history, not the map value
issues.evidence: Anderson history defect remains in explicitly dead scalar EFS driver; public fit_reml rejects every route reaching it.

issues.title: Binomial/log mean space: remaining edge cases (positive offset, clip threshold, discrete, SCOP)
issues.evidence: Ordinary 4-row binomial/identity fit falsely converges and clips raw means outside [0,1]; several original log-link items fixed, near-one log refusal remains.
issues.proposed_fix: Enforce binomial/identity probability domains with correct likelihood derivatives, verified centered starts and rare bounded working-row phase I; disclose boundary stops.

issues.title: Follow-up nits from #451 and #452 (phase timing, metrics docs)
issues.evidence: Original overflow/absorb items fixed; per-fit window inclusive timing can be zero below positive exclusive time; documentation nits remain.
issues.proposed_fix: Include still-open caller phases in per-fit inclusive timings and correct verified-row metrics documentation.

issues.title: Follow-ups from #453: overflow warning, fallback replay, docs and tests

issues.proposed_fix: Chunk compensated replay and rebuild overflowed drops after coordinate shifts, with exact Numeric product pieces for retained cancellations.

issues.title: Follow-ups from #540: tracemalloc tests and other threads, Numeric relativity overflow, face lost on repair

issues.title: GPD wall disclosure: deferred review follow-ups from #558

issues.title: Truncation bounds: read pd.NA as a missing bound, and only on retained rows

issues.proposed_fix: Convert nullable truncation bounds only after retained-row selection and report retained original positions.

issues.title: Censoring separation scan: gate links per censoring side
issues.evidence: Censor separation scan gates entire links rather than individual endpoints, missing sqrt/right recession despite correctly accepting sqrt/left.
issues.proposed_fix: Apply built-in censoring recession flags to each link endpoint, retaining conservative custom-family behavior.
